item.title: Brazilian Women in Munich
item.description: When we make a change in our lives, we leave our comfort zone and know we’ll have to face many fears and challenges before we feel secure. That’s what happened to us too when we arrived in Munich, lost, full of fears, looking for support in each other and in our family back in Brazil. Soon I felt it wasn’t enough, I was feeling alone and with a hole of homesickness in my heart.

item.title: We're moving to Munich in Germany
item.description: Change is always good! Yes, but not always. Here we’ll share our experiences moving to and living in Germany, we’ll talk much more about Munich - which is where we live now - our difficulties and how we faced them. A family of three, two adults and a two-year-old child, who knew nothing of the German language and even less about the country’s culture, trying to fulfill a dream of living unique and transformative experiences.

item.title: We decided to move abroad, where do we start?
item.description:
At first, deciding to move abroad can be fascinating, but it takes a little effort and dedication to make it a reality. We wanted to live in another country and have the chance to get to know a culture different from our own, but how did we start fighting for this dream?
